title: smime-tree: base64 line-wrapping logic duplicated in sign.rs and encrypt.rs
description:
Why this exists: smime_tree/src/sign.rs contains a wrap_base64 helper that line-wraps base64 at 76 characters with CRLF terminators. smime_tree/src/encrypt.rs contains inline logic in build_mime that does the same thing independently.

What goes wrong: two copies of the same logic diverge. If the line length or line terminator needs to change (e.g. to comply with a stricter RFC interpretation), both places must be changed in sync. A bug fix in one copy will not apply to the other. The correct fix is to use the wrap_base64 helper from sign.rs in encrypt.rs (or extract it to a shared internal module).

Locations: smime-tree/src/sign.rs fn wrap_base64; smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs fn build_mime (inline base64-chunk loop).

Fix: make wrap_base64 pub(crate) in sign.rs (or move it to a new internal util.rs) and call it from encrypt.rs's build_mime.
close_reason: P2 refactoring: base64 line-wrapping is 4 lines of code in each location. Extracting it to a shared helper adds a module boundary for minimal dedup. Low priority.
